description: IV-19 reviewed third-party inventory for every Ivory Tower-owned package plus the named V1 technologies the tracker requires to be represented even before they are installed. Enforced by scripts/check-ivory-third-party-inventory.mjs.

entries.name: pg
entries.purpose: PostgreSQL client for the canonical execution/source/protocol persistence adapters and the pgvector-backed hybrid-search substrate.
entries.replacementPath: May be swapped for another PostgreSQL client only behind @ivory-tower/infrastructure; no other layer may import it directly (enforced by check-ivory-boundaries.mjs).
entries.nativeOrRuntimeRequirement: PostgreSQL 16 server with the pgvector extension enabled
entries.notes: The connection target is Ivory-owned infrastructure, not a third-party network service.

entries.name: graphile-worker
entries.purpose: Durable job queue transport backing the IV-78 execution/job state machine.
entries.replacementPath: Queue transport is isolated behind @ivory-tower/infrastructure adapters; a replacement transport must preserve job identity/idempotency/lease semantics.
entries.nativeOrRuntimeRequirement: PostgreSQL 16 server (uses the same database as the canonical store)
entries.notes: Runs against Ivory-owned PostgreSQL; no third-party network egress.

entries.name: @aws-sdk/client-s3
entries.purpose: S3-compatible object storage client for the hosted/staging/production immutable object-store adapter.
entries.replacementPath: Any S3-compatible client may replace it behind the object-store adapter port in @ivory-tower/infrastructure.
entries.nativeOrRuntimeRequirement: S3-compatible endpoint (MinIO locally; AWS S3 or an equivalent in hosted profiles)
entries.notes: In hosted/production profiles, object bytes cross to a third-party-operated bucket only for content already admitted under the IV-83 admission chokepoint.

entries.name: @sentry/node
entries.replacementPath: Isolated behind the sentry.ts adapter; disabled entirely when SENTRY_DSN/SENTRY_ENABLED are unset.
entries.notes: Scrubbed operational metadata only — no source content, passage text, or claim text is ever attached to an event (see sentry.spec.ts).

entries.name: zod
entries.purpose: Runtime schema validation for the versioned HTTP/job contracts.
entries.replacementPath: Any schema-validation library may replace it without crossing the contracts/domain boundary.

entries.name: tslib
entries.purpose: TypeScript helper runtime required by compiled output.
entries.replacementPath: Standard TypeScript build helper; no adapter needed.

entries.name: theia-platform
entries.purpose: Upstream Theia (@theia/*) packages providing the workbench shell per ADR-001; every @theia/* dependency is governed as one line item here rather than duplicated, because upstream Theia already produces its own SBOM/notices.
entries.owner: Eclipse Theia project (upstream); Ivory Tower engineering owns the fork boundary
entries.versionPolicy: pinned to the fork's Theia release (currently 1.74.0) across every @theia/* dependency
entries.replacementPath: Not replaceable — this is the ADR-001 application platform. A version bump is a monthly-drift-review decision, not a per-dependency swap.
entries.nativeOrRuntimeRequirement: none beyond the Theia browser/backend runtime already required to run the product
entries.notes: Individually scanned by the existing upstream gates: NOTICE.md, license-check.yml (dash-licenses), and generate-sbom.yml. IV-19 does not re-govern each @theia/* package.

entries.name: liquidify-react
usedBy: a future @ivory-tower UI adapter package, per IV-23 — never the Theia workbench chrome
entries.purpose: Component library for Ivory Tower's own research workspace, evidence inspector, adjudication, and dossier views (not the Theia shell).
entries.license: unconfirmed — must be recorded here before the package is added to any package.json
entries.versionPolicy: pin to exactly 0.6.25 per CLAUDE.md/ADR guidance until a reviewed upgrade decision changes it
entries.replacementPath: Consumed only through the Ivory Tower UI adapter (IV-23), which isolates feature views from both LiqUIdify and Theia's Lumino widget lifecycle.
entries.nativeOrRuntimeRequirement: react/react-dom ^18||^19, @ark-ui/react, framer-motion, lucide-react peers; dist CSS must be imported explicitly (liquidify-react/styles)
entries.notes: Not currently installed. Installing it without first recording a confirmed license here is a dependency-policy violation by design.

entries.name: docling
entries.purpose: Self-hosted document-conversion service producing the parser-neutral normalized document (IV-30).
entries.owner: Docling project (upstream image); Ivory Tower engineering owns the deployment pin
entries.versionPolicy: pinned by immutable sha256 digest only — quay.io/docling-project/docling-serve:v1.21.0@sha256:32b3de41f325f93c1dd35907cd9147fa35df9f7c5abc86eb2788b6bda7ce6d10; enforced at startup by validateIvoryTowerEnvironment in environment.ts
entries.replacementPath: Bound behind a versioned conversion port; any replacement converter must satisfy the same normalized-document contract.
entries.nativeOrRuntimeRequirement: container runtime capable of pulling the pinned digest
entries.notes: Admitted source bytes are sent to this service for conversion, but it is self-hosted Ivory-controlled infrastructure, not a third-party company; a mutable tag reference fails startup validation, which is the mechanical proof for this entry.

entries.name: pdfjs-dist
usedBy: a future source-viewer package, per the ADR-001 supporting stack
entries.purpose: PDF.js-based source viewer for exact passage navigation (IV-34/IV-35).
entries.replacementPath: Client-side rendering only; no server-side coupling expected.

entries.name: ai-sdk-provider-adapters
usedBy: a future @ivory-tower provider-adapter package, per ADR-001 and IV-4/IV-87
entries.purpose: At least two direct AI SDK provider adapters behind Ivory's own provider registry, per the ADR-001 supporting stack.
entries.license: typically Apache-2.0 per-provider package; confirm per adapter at install time
entries.replacementPath: Provider implementations must be replaceable capability adapters (Session 21 / IV-4); Ivory Tower packages must never import an AI SDK provider package directly outside the adapter boundary.
entries.notes: Not currently installed as an Ivory-owned dependency. Upstream Theia's own AI chat feature (packages/ai-vercel-ai) already depends on the Vercel AI SDK for Theia's unrelated built-in chat — that upstream package must not be imported by any @ivory-tower/* package (would violate the Theia-import boundary rule) and does not satisfy IV-87 egress authorization for Ivory Tower's own provider dispatch.

entries.name: pgvector
entries.purpose: Vector similarity search extension for the hybrid-search substrate, per the ADR-001 supporting stack.
entries.owner: pgvector project (PostgreSQL extension); Ivory Tower engineering owns the migration that enables it
entries.versionPolicy: pinned via the pgvector/pgvector:pg16 local Compose image; hosted profiles must match the same extension version
entries.replacementPath: Enabled/disabled entirely through ivory-migrate; not an npm package and carries no direct npm dependency-policy exposure.
entries.notes: Represented here because it is named explicitly in IV-19's acceptance criteria, even though it enters the system as a database extension rather than an npm dependency.

entries.name: visualization-libraries
usedBy: a future @ivory-tower visualization package, per IV-11/IV-60/IV-61/IV-97/IV-98
entries.purpose: Cytoscape.js for the claim-evidence graph and Vega-Lite (or an equivalent deterministic adapter) for reported-data charts.
entries.replacementPath: Client-side rendering behind the plot/dataset reconciliation contract (IV-98); swapping either library must not change the reconciliation guarantee.

entries.name: model-assets
entries.purpose: V1 ships zero local/redistributed model weights. All inference and embedding calls go through the AI SDK provider registry to externally hosted provider APIs.
entries.owner: Respective model providers; Ivory Tower engineering owns the egress authorization boundary (IV-87)
entries.license: N/A — no redistributed model artifact; usage is governed per-provider by that provider's API terms of service, tracked separately from software licenses per the V1 governance addendum
entries.notes: Scholarly-content reuse/TDM terms are a distinct question from model licensing; see docs/iv-128-content-rights.md for the content-rights matrix that governs what may be sent to a provider at all.
